description: This file defines the TwigEngine class, which implements the EngineInterface for rendering templates using Twig in a PHP application. It manages loading templates, rendering them with parameters, and checking for template existence within the Goteo application.

classes.name: TwigEngine
classes.description: A class implementing a template engine for Goteo application using Twig, capable of rendering templates and checking their existence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigEngine with a URL generator, sets up the filesystem loader for templates, and adds routing extension to Twig.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template with given parameters, may throw various Twig exceptions.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a given template exists.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a template is supported by this engine, delegating to exists method.
